name: agent-roles
description: Four roles injected at the start of every agent — a worker session delegates to subagents, a dispatcher session runs worker sessions in tmux windows, a task subagent ends its turn with findings, a resident subagent stays alive and reports by message

default_role.title: Default role
default_role.description: Role injected into a session that a launcher did not give a role: the name of a file under roles/ without .md, or none for no role. A role set through FP_CC_AUTH_SWITCH_ROLE or FP_CC_AUTH_SWITCH_ROLE_PROMPT wins over this option.

resident_agent_types.title: Resident agent types
resident_agent_types.description: Third-party agent types that stay alive for a whole run and report through SendMessage; they get the resident subagent role instead of the task subagent role, like the plugin's own agent-roles:resident. Empty by default.
